headline: Kazakhstan Court Bars Coinbase and Others From Unlicensed AIFC Services
summary: A court in Kazakhstan issued injunctions barring Coinbase and five other entities from providing unlicensed crypto services within the Astana International Financial Centre.
why: The Astana International Financial Centre operates under distinct legal frameworks to regulate financial services and digital asset providers within Kazakhstan.

impacts.name: Coinbase Global
impacts.why: Regulatory injunctions restrict regional market access and commercial operations for digital asset exchanges.
